name: Stretch S
blurb: A splayed tubular leg that carries a whole office from one set of parts: round and square tables, single desks, returns, benches and meeting tables.
slotHint: Stretch S: bench desking run with screens and cable management

name: Stretch V
blurb: The beam adjusts, so one chassis covers a span of sizes: desks, returns, benches and meeting tables off eight part numbers.
slotHint: Stretch V: face-to-face bench with side screens and wire channel

name: Stretch F
blurb: A frame leg at the ends and a panel leg at the centre, across team benches, single desks, meeting tables and a high table.
slotHint: Stretch F: team benches with frame legs and desk screens
lead: One leg family for the team floor and the meeting space: frame legs carry the ends of every top, a solid panel leg carries the middle of the long ones, and the benches take desk screens. Sizes, tops and finishes are quoted to your plan.

name: Apex
blurb: A tapered, splayed leg under executive desks and team benches, photographed in four leg finishes.
slotHint: Apex: team bench with splayed legs and desk screens
lead: One leg drawn two ways: angled out at the corners of an executive desk and its return, and paired under a team bench with desk screens. Sizes, tops and finishes are quoted to your plan.

name: Element
blurb: Slim tapered legs and a broad panel leg across executive desks, team benches and conference tables, photographed in four leg finishes.
slotHint: Element: team bench with a panel leg and desk screens
lead: Slim tapered legs at the corners and a broad panel leg at the centre, from the cabin to the conference room to the team floor. Sizes, tops and finishes are quoted to your plan.

name: Stretch E
blurb: An angular, open leg that gives conference and cabin tables a strong, sculptural profile.
slotHint: Stretch E: cabin table on an angular open leg
lead: Made for meeting rooms and cabins. The angular, open leg gives a long conference table a strong profile, and the same leg carries through to the cabin desk, so both rooms read as one family. Sizes, tops and finishes are quoted to your plan.

name: Stretch R
blurb: A curved top on a broad, tapering leg, for rooms where the table is the centre of attention.
slotHint: Stretch R: conference table with a curved top on broad legs
lead: Stretch R pairs a curved top with a broad, tapering leg, giving conference and cabin tables a softer, more formal presence. Sizes, tops and finishes are quoted to your plan.
